title: GeoLibre plugin registry entry
description: One plugin's entry in registry/<id>.json. plugin-registry.json is generated from these files.

id.description: Unique plugin id. Must match the file name, the manifest, and the exported plugin.
id.$comment: must be lowercase letters and digits, separated by single . _ or - characters

name.description: Display name shown in the marketplace.

version.description: Plugin version. Must match the manifest.

description.description: Short summary shown on the plugin card.

homepage.$comment: must be an http:// or https:// URL

repository.description: The plugin's source repository, linked from its catalog page.

issues.description: Where to report problems with the plugin, linked from its catalog page.

license.description: The plugin's license, as an SPDX identifier or expression such as MIT or Apache-2.0 OR MIT.
license.$comment: must be an SPDX license identifier or expression, e.g. MIT or Apache-2.0 OR MIT

manifestUrl.description: plugins/<dir>/plugin.json, or an absolute HTTPS URL for a plugin hosted elsewhere.
manifestUrl.$comment: must be plugins/<dir>/<file>.json (no .. segments) or an https:// URL

source.description: The plugin's release zip, for a plugin whose code isn't committed here. CI downloads it, checks sha256, and serves it from plugins/<id>/. manifestUrl must then be plugins/<dir>/plugin.json: plugins/<id>/ for a new plugin, or the folder a migrated plugin was served from.

sha256.$comment: must be the zip's SHA-256 as 64 lowercase hex characters

categories.description: One to four categories from the fixed list.

minGeoLibreVersion.description: Lowest GeoLibre version the plugin supports.

publishableSettings.description: Project-state keys that survive "Strip credentials" and shared exports: true keeps the plugin's whole state, an array keeps only those keys.
publishableSettings.$comment: must be true or a non-empty array of up to 64 unique key names

screenshots.description: Up to four screenshots shown on the plugin's catalog page. Each path is a PNG, JPEG or WebP file inside the release zip (relative to plugin.json), so it needs a source.

path.$comment: must be a relative path to a .png, .jpg, .jpeg or .webp file in the release zip, without . or .. segments

caption.description: What the screenshot shows; also its alternative text.

trimmedString.$comment: must not be empty or start or end with whitespace

semver.$comment: must be a SemVer 2.0 version such as 1.2.3 or 1.2.3-beta.1
